تكالبت (form VI)

# تَكَالَبْتَ (takālabta) /ta.kaː.lab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَالَبَ (takālaba)
# تَكَالَبْتِ (takālabti) /ta.kaː.lab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَالَبَ (takālaba)
# تَكَالَبَتْ (takālabat) /ta.kaː.la.bat/: third-person fem
